name: select-state-on-parent
message: `:hover` under select.descendant("svg") is the state of this element, not of the svg
help: for the svg's own state, put it in the target: `[select.descendant("svg:hover")]`; for this element's, read it through a relation

name: unsupported-contextual-target
message: a contextual target is one compound selector: an element name, classes, attribute selectors and pseudo-classes, with no combinator or pseudo-element
help: for example select.descendant('svg'), select.descendant('.ts-chart__grid') or select.child('[data-slot="icon"]:hover'); a pseudo-element is a key inside the target's style
